changes.title: Your work on the first screen.
changes.text: Your best gates, stairs and wine doors are spread across 13 gallery pages. The concept opens with your own photos and a short gallery of six standout projects.

changes.title: A quote request one tap away.
changes.text: The current site loads without a secure connection, so Chrome marks it Not Secure, and the phone number can't be tapped. The concept is secure, with tap to call and a Request a free quote button at the top.

changes.title: Since 1964, said up front.
changes.text: Your About page tells the story of hand forged work since 1964, and customers praise your craftsmanship. The concept puts that history and three of their quotes on the homepage.
